description: Ephemeral event stream from a receiver station. Emits batched aircraft operations per poll cycle. Does not write to any repository.

main.description: Subscribe to realtime events from this receiver station.

cursor.description: Not currently used for backfill. Reserved for future use.

event.description: A batch of operations from a single poll cycle.

seq.description: The stream sequence number of this message.

station.description: Strong reference to the emitting receiver's at.adsb.receiver.station record.

time.description: Timestamp of the poll cycle that produced this batch.

ops.description: List of operations in this batch.

sig.description: Signature over the DAG-CBOR encoding of this frame (excluding the sig field itself). Produced by the station's stream signing key.

broadcastOp.description: A single operation within a broadcast event.

record.description: The record payload. Shape determined by record's $type field.

identity.description: Represents a station coming online or updating its identity.

seq.description: The stream sequence number of this message.

time.description: Timestamp of when this identity event was produced.

station.description: Strong reference to the station record.
